name: Hotel Prince de Galles
insider_take: Art Deco glamour meets Parisian sophistication in this legendary hotel where fashion icons and royalty have walked the halls since 1929.
whats_special: This historic gem on Avenue George V features an extraordinary mosaic façade and houses one of Paris's most stunning interior courtyards with a retractable glass roof. The hotel's rooftop terrace offers unparalleled views of the Eiffel Tower, while its location puts you steps from the Golden Triangle's luxury boutiques including Chanel, Louis Vuitton, and Hermès flagship stores.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 6-7 for the best Eiffel Tower views, and visit the rooftop terrace at sunset for the most Instagram-worthy shots of the Iron Lady.
dont_miss: The hotel's famous mosaic entrance hall, a masterpiece of 1930s craftsmanship, and the nearby Crazy Horse cabaret (just 2 minutes walk). Take advantage of your prime location to explore the Champs-Élysées and place yourself perfectly between the Arc de Triomphe and the Seine River.
pros: Prime location near Champs-Élysées and Arc de Triomphe
Elegant Art Deco architecture and sophisticated Parisian design
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Luxurious amenities including spa and fine dining restaurant
cons: Limited parking availability in central Paris location
